newsitem.title: UK: Euro vacuum gas oil better but US arb doubtful.
newsitem.headline: Euro vacuum gas oil better but US arb doubtful.

text.p: European VGO prices were firmer on Friday, boosted by crude and gas oil's strength, but sellers offered above market levels, which slowed business, traders said.
Better U.S. demand also lay behind some of the price increase.
"Some people stepped in and paid up some numbers," said one trader.
Low sulphur cargoes out of France and Italy were heard picked up by traders for shipment across the Atlantic, though dealers were sceptical the operation was currently profitable.
"Its marginal to the U.S. and I don't know it if makes sense to do it," said a trader. "May is pretty much spoken for, with most people looking now at June barrels."
High sulphur prices were under a little more pressure, with demand weak.
